title: Create Simulation Design Grid — create_design
text: ... Named arguments; vectors become grid factors, scalars repeated. pop_values_x supports fixed params, conditions (bundles dependent params), cross factors (see expand_pop_values_x). .labels Optional named list label vectors unnamed varying factors: analysis_model, fit_options, conditions, lv_cov, etc. Example: .labels = list(conditions = c("weak","strong")). .seed Base seed; seed = .seed + row_number() per scenario.

title: Create Simulation Design Grid — create_design
text: Tibble one row per scenario; label columns (e.g. condition_label, analysis_model_label) names .labels provided.

title: Create Simulation Design Grid — create_design
text: run_multifactor(): Run simulation design grid (calls run_simulation).

title: Create Simulation Design Grid — create_design
code: dvn <- dySEM::build_dvn(n_items_x = 3, x_stem = "x", x_delim2 = "_",   distinguish_1 = "A", distinguish_2 = "B") script <- dySEM::scriptCor(dvn, scaleset = "FF", lvname = "X",   constr_dy_meas = c("loadings", "intercepts", "residuals"),   constr_dy_struct = c("variances", "means")) design <- create_design(   pop_model_x = "Cor",   analysis_model = script,   n_dyads = c(50, 100),   n_items_x = 3,   pop_values_x = list(     intercepts = rep(0, 3),     coresids = c(.1, .12, .08),     conditions = list(       weak = list(loadings_p1 = c(.75,.8,.55), loadings_p2 = c(.75,.8,.55),                  residuals_p1 = c(.44,.36,.7), residuals_p2 = c(.44,.36,.7)),       strong = list(loadings_p1 = c(.7,.83,.87), loadings_p2 = c(.7,.83,.87),                    residuals_p1 = c(.49,.31,.24), residuals_p2 = c(.49,.31,.24))     ),     lv_cov = list(low = 0.3, med = 0.5, high = 0.8)   ),   .seed = 12345 )

what: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
text: Build design grid model choice analysis: multiple DGPs (pop_model_x) per-DGP population parameters, fixed set candidate analysis models fit generated dataset.

title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
code: create_modelchoice_design(   analysis_models,   pop_values_x,   pop_model_x,   pop_generator = NULL,   ...,   .labels = NULL,   .seed = NULL )

title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
text: analysis_models Named list lavaan scripts (length >= 2). Names become analysis_model_labels. Order: constrained (simplest) first. pop_values_x Named list keyed pop_model_x. element expand_pop_values_x-compatible (fixed, conditions, cross factors). Uni structure: loadings, residuals, coresids. Cor structure: loadings_p1, loadings_p2, residuals_p1, residuals_p2, coresids, lv_cov. pop_model_x Character vector DGP levels (e.g. c("Uni", "Cor")). Names pop_values_x must contain . pop_generator Optional named vector mapping pop_model_x "Uni" "Cor" data generation. NULL, inferred parameter names (loadings -> Uni, loadings_p1 -> Cor). ... factors (e.g. n_dyads, n_items_x) expand. .labels Optional named list expand_pop_values_x labels (e.g. list(conditions = c("weak","strong"))). .seed Base seed; seed = .seed + row_number() per scenario.

title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
text: Tibble one row per scenario: analysis_models list-column, analysis_model_labels, pop_model_x, pop_values_x, pop_generator, design columns.

title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
text: Model order: analysis_models must ordered simplest (constrained) first. chi2_diff_startsimple chi2_diff_startcomplex, LRT compares nested models; complex model listed first, test logic wrong. Example loading invariance: list(loading_inv = script_load, configural = script_none).

title: Create Model Choice Simulation Design — create_modelchoice_design
code: dvn <- dySEM::build_dvn(n_items_x = 3, x_stem = "x", x_delim2 = "_",   distinguish_1 = "A", distinguish_2 = "B") script_uni <- dySEM::scriptUni(dvn, scaleset = "FF", lvname = "X",   constr_dy_meas = c("loadings", "intercepts", "residuals"),   constr_dy_struct = "none") script_cor <- dySEM::scriptCor(dvn, scaleset = "FF", lvname = "X",   constr_dy_meas = c("loadings", "intercepts", "residuals"),   constr_dy_struct = c("variances", "means")) design <- create_modelchoice_design(   pop_model_x = c("Uni", "Cor"),   analysis_models = list(uni = script_uni, cor = script_cor),   pop_values_x = list(     Uni = list(loadings = c(.75,.8,.55), residuals = c(.44,.36,.7),                coresids = c(.1,.12,.08)),     Cor = list(loadings_p1 = c(.75,.8,.55), loadings_p2 = c(.75,.8,.55),                residuals_p1 = c(.44,.36,.7), residuals_p2 = c(.44,.36,.7),                coresids = c(.1,.12,.08), lv_cov = 0.3)   ),   n_dyads = c(50, 100),   n_items_x = 3,   .seed = 12345 )

title: Expand pop_values_x Into Scenarios — expand_pop_values_x
text: Converts tiered structure tibble row one scenario's population values. Supports: (1) fixed params supplied recycled, (2) condition bundles mathematically dependent params (e.g. loadings + residuals), (3) cross factors vary independently. conditions cross factors named lists, names become label columns grouping.

title: Expand pop_values_x Into Scenarios — expand_pop_values_x
code: expand_pop_values_x(pop_values_x, labels = NULL)

title: Expand pop_values_x Into Scenarios — expand_pop_values_x
text: pop_values_x Named list three optional tiers: Fixed: Elements single value vector (supply , recycled every scenario). Bundles (conditions): list named lists; sublist coherent condition (e.g. loadings + residuals must stay paired). Use names labels: list(weak = ..., strong = ...). Cross factors: Elements lists scalars/vectors (e.g. lv_cov = list(low = 0.3, med = 0.5, high = 0.8)). Names become label columns. labels Optional named list label vectors conditions cross factors unnamed (e.g. list(conditions = c("weak","strong"),   lv_cov = c("low","med","high"))). Used fallback names missing.

title: Expand pop_values_x Into Scenarios — expand_pop_values_x
